newsitems.title: The Last of the Druids Microtransactions Are Now Available in Store
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: Microtransactions from the Last of the Druids Mystery Box have finally been released in the store for Path of Exile 1 and Path of Exile 2! From Armour Sets to Portals and Level-Up Effects, there are over 60 new microtransactions available, giving you even more ways to customise your Exile and show off your style. Check out the full selection in the store, or watch the video below to take a closer look at everything included in the Last of the Druids Mystery Box. Thank you for your support!

newsitems.title: Fan Art Competition
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: It’s been a while since we last hosted a fan art competition, and with the recent updates to Path of Exile 1 and Path of Exile 2, we’re sure our community artists have plenty of inspiration to draw from. We’re excited to announce a Path of Exile Fan Art Competition inspired by the Return of the Ancients and Curse of the Allflame expansions! The prize pool includes official merchandise and in-game microtransactions. newsitems.contents: Yesterday, Path of Exile 1 Game Designers Andrew and Octavian sat down with community streamer Zizaran to discuss Path of Exile: Curse of the Allflame. In case you missed it, check out the VOD below.

newsitems.author: CommunityTeam_GGG

newsitems.title: After a year and a half of rigorous testing, Path of Exile 2 devs finally convinced Nvidia to fix a driver bug by sending it an entire PC
newsitems.author: Tyler Colp
newsitems.contents: There was a point in the most recent Path of Exile 2 league that I thought I would have to quit playing the game. Every 20 minutes or so, the entire game would freeze. I'd wait for a solid 30 seconds before everything came back to life, praying I wouldn't lose my character the second I had control again... Read more.

newsitems.title: Introducing the Path of Exile 1: Curse of the Allflame Mystery Box
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: We've just released the Curse of the Allflame Mystery Box, a new mystery box with no duplicate microtransactions! There are 56 microtransactions (including variations) that you can find in the Curse of the Allflame Mystery Box. Many of these microtransactions have a varying number of thematic variations, and you'll never receive a duplicate copy of a variation that you have already opened. For example, if you open one variant of a microtransaction, you may later receive another variant, but you'll never get a duplicate! newsitems.title: Curse of the Allflame Challenge Rewards
newsitems.author: blakej
newsitems.contents: In the Curse of the Allflame league, you'll be able to earn four new free cosmetic rewards by completing 40 new challenges. Better yet, every reward you unlock can also be used in Path of Exile 2! At 12, 24, 32, and 36 challenges you’ll receive the Oceanic Weapon Effect, Fangtooth Moray Pet, Captain’s Wheel Back Attachment and Oceanic Portal Effect respectively. Completing challenges also grants you pieces of the Allflame Challenger Trophy Hideout Decoration!
